columns: Configurable event inputs (in EXTI_RPR.RPIFn and EXTI_FPR.FPIFn)
tables.text_helper: Table 104, "Masking functionality", in section 16.4 (EXTI functional behavior) on page 451. Columns: CPU interrupt enable (in EXTI_IMR.IMn), CPU event enable (in EXTI_EMR.EMn), Configurable event inputs (in EXTI_RPR.RPIFn and EXTI_FPR.FPIFn), Exti(n) interrupt(1), CPU event, CPU wake-up. 4 data row(s). Notes: 1. The single exti(n) interrupt goes to the CPU. If no interrupt is required for CPU(m), the exti(n) interrupt must be masked in the CPU NVIC.; 2. Only if CPU event is enabled in EXTI_IMR.IMn.
